Our return and exchange policy for delayed or lost shipments: 
- If a package is confirmed lost or damaged during transit, we file a claim with the carrier on your behalf.
- You will receive a full refund or a replacement product, depending on your preference.
- The claim process takes 5–10 business days to complete after we verify the loss.
- For first-time buyers, we offer a 15-day window to initiate an exchange or return for any delayed or lost items.
- All claims are reviewed by our fulfillment team, and you’ll receive a confirmation email once the process is complete.
- If the item is damaged, we will replace it with a new one at no cost to you.
